programmes.d: Cesar tries to help Slick a fear-ridden dog who was rescued after living in a crate for 15 hours a day and Pepper, another rescue dog with issues.
Ava, a small mixed-breed spins constantly; Gus, a large dog who greets people by throwing its body at them.
Churchill is usually a well-mannered dog, but around other animals he's a monster, and lovable pit bull Maya can be a handful.
Cesar takes the spoiled Bubba down a notch; discover why German shepherd Garret never stops chasing his tail.

A rescued mastiff likes to chew everything and barks incessantly; Paris is a temperamental, long-haired Chihuahua.

A Dogo Argentino with canine aggression; a terrier/corgi mix who becomes aggressive when faced with traveling.

Cesar helps two former gang members through Homeboy Industries, an outreach program designed to break the cycle of gang violence but who have problem dogs at home.

A 12-year-old beagle mix displays unpredictable aggression; a couple tries to fit an aggressive puppy into their family.

A couple fear their border terrier is untrainable; an excitable English bulldog causes trouble for its owner.

A terrier rescued via the Internet is a handful to manage and bites anyone who tries to touch his hindquarters; pit bull problems.
